page0.text:
...We walk through the forest.
We're the only living humans among these infinite trees.

page1.text:
I don't hear the breathing of any beasts, and the plants in winter are as lifeless as corpses.
The endless sea of trees that seem to go on forever makes me constantly feel apprehension.

page2.text:
It's already been three hours since we entered the forest.
It's way past noon, and just as I have become unable to tell whether there have been any changes in the landscape...

page3.text:
"...Found it.
...Geez, I'm fed up even though I knew about it. They really built something like that in a place like this."

page4.text:
I follow Tohsaka's line of sight.
There's only darkness ahead.
Between the trees.
There is some incredibly out of place thing that can be seen through cracks that are so small, they could easily be missed by anybody who doesn't pay close attention.

page5.text:
"...What is that? A... Wall?"
"It's a wall. Geez, what's up with that? They brought that whole thing from their country."

page6.text:
Tohsaka curses and heads to the strange object we see in the distance.
I follow after her, still bewildered, unable to grasp what it is.

page7.text:
We get out of the forest.
The forest that seemed to be endless abruptly ends.
No, it seems like the traces of the forest vanished, as if they carved out just this part with a big spoon.

page8.text:
The gray sky curving above us is so high that I can't see everything.
A huge dome-like space.
This is more like an underground kingdom, instead of an open space.

page9.text:
That was Illyasviel's dwelling.
The old castle built in the middle of the forest.
It is a solitary castle in the forest that has no visitors, is too big for that girl to live in, and is too lonely to live in alone.

page10.text:
...
...Anyway, it does no good to falter here.
According to Tohsaka, Illyasviel knows that we came here.
Then we should go confidently from the front entrance to show that we don't have any enmity.

page11.text:
"All right, let's go, Tohsaka... Tohsaka?"
Tohsaka looks up at the castle with an alarming expression.
Her side profile looks as tense as it does when she's confronting an enemy.

page12.text:
"Tohsaka. Is there something bothering you?"
"...Yeah. There's someone else other than us."
"Of course there is. This is where that Illya girl and Berserker live."

page13.text:
"That's not it, there's someone else besides them... Shirou, we're going to enter from over here."
"Huh... W-wait...!"

page14.text:
Without a chance to stop her, Tohsaka starts running to the big tree by the wall.
No, that's not all.
Tohsaka grabs onto a branch and skillfully climbs up.

page15.text:
...
I look up in astonishment.
Tohsaka looks around the castle and...
She jumps and kicks at the castle's second floor.

page16.text:
A shattering sound.
A window breaks, and the red figure disappears into the castle.

page17.text:
"Come on, hurry...! Something's seriously wrong with this castle...!"
"Ugh... Geez, aren't we here to talk...!?"
But, what's done is done.
I also climb the tree and jump into the second floor of the castle like Tohsaka.

page18.text:
I go out to the hallway from the room we invaded.
Before I can even marvel at how magnificent this place is, the abnormality Tohsaka mentioned earlier grabs my attention.

page19.text:
The sound echoing is definitely the sound of battle.
The sound of swords clashing.
But... Is a storm-like sword fight like this even possible?
Even the most intense sword fight that I've witnessed so far, the one between Saber and Berserker, didn't make these kinds of sounds.

page20.text:
"...Oh."
Then I suddenly realize.
This doesn't sound like your average sword fight.
This is one against many... There is literally a war going on somewhere in this castle.

page21.text:
There's no doubt that one of them is Berserker.
This castle is Illyasviel's castle.
If a battle were to occur, it would only be when Berserker is attacking an intruder.

page22.text:
I start running.
The sounds are echoing from below.
Judging from where the sounds are coming from relative to our entry point, the battle is in the center of the castle... In the reception hall.
